name: Fig & Cinnamon Cordial
instructions: Peel and thinly slice fresh figs, then add them to a jar with an equal weight of sugar. For every 250 g of sugar, add 3 g of cinnamon.
Let sit for 24 hours, stirring 2-3 times to help dissolve the sugar.
Strain through a nut milk bag and measure the yield.
Acidify with an equal amount of fresh lime juice, or an acid solution (for every 89 g of water: 4 g citric acid, 2 g malic acid, 5 g sugar, and a tiny pinch of salt).
